plan.archetype: Efficient early attacks transitioning into dexterity and poison
plan.bossPrep: Establish reliable damage and dexterity, maintain Weak, and prepare substantial block for turn-three Dismember. Enter with a healthy HP buffer.
plan.summary: Prioritize early damage and one AoE, then strengthen block and sustained damage. Upgrade core cards and remove basics gradually. Fight elites only with sufficient health and improved offense.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with stronger defense and consistent setup
plan.bossPrep: Heal now. Establish enchanted Fumes and Accelerant, maintain Weak, and reserve Ghost for poorly blocked Dismember. Use Skill Potion when defense is insufficient.
plan.summary: Existing poison supplies sustained damage. Improve block quality, dexterity, and setup consistency; remove Strikes. Avoid elites until defenses improve. Prioritize Accelerant upgrades when health permits.

plan.archetype: Poison scaling with free attacks and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Upgrade Accelerant and defensive powers. Establish Fumes and After Image early. Maintain Weak; save Ghost for Rocket’s laser and Tincture for setup.
plan.summary: Free enchanted Strikes improve immediate damage without spending defensive energy. Prioritize dexterity, efficient block, and draw. Replace Defends only after acquiring better defenses. Use the four campfires to balance healing and core upgrades.

plan.archetype: Accelerated poison with dexterity defense and efficient cycling
plan.bossPrep: Enter healthy with potions. Establish poison and defensive powers. Avoid unnecessary first-phase skills; they increase enemy Strength. Reapply poison after phase transitions.
plan.summary: Prioritize dexterity, strong block, and Weak at shops. Preserve free Strikes. Replan around Fur Coat marks; fight marked elites, avoid unmarked elites. Upgrade defenses when safe and conserve health for consecutive bosses.
